description: Filesystem read + local read-only shell. No network, no write tools, no gh. allowed_tools carries no bare 'Bash': per ADR-1643 Amendment 5 (#1678), a bare tool name in --allowed-tools is an unconditional grant that overrides the settings file's rule-scoped entries, so Bash is left to the settings file's rule-scoped Bash(...) allow entries, which the CLI evaluates per segment. This posture's security value comes from its deny list, its disallowed_tools, and those rule-scoped allow entries together — not from the allow list's narrowness alone.
